# STY020 `too-complex`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

A procedure's cyclomatic complexity exceeds 10.

## Why

Cyclomatic complexity counts the independent paths through a procedure (1 + each `if`, `else if`,
`do`, `case`, type/rank guard). Above about 10 (McCabe's threshold) a procedure is
hard to test path by path and hard to read; split it into smaller procedures. Nested procedures are
measured separately.

## Reported

```fortran
subroutine update_everything(...)   ! 25 branches
```

## Preferred

```fortran
! one procedure per step, each with a few branches
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[STY020] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = STY020` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `S901` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
